# Refactor Enemy Gym Scenes (epic)

## Problem statement

The first three enemy gym scenes — E1 Scout (`GymScout.ts`), E2 Diver (`GymDiver.ts`), E3 Tank (`GymTank.ts`) — were built independently and share ~90% identical structure: formation spawn loop, EXPLODE/SHOOT HUD buttons, status text, hint line, back-to-index button, formation drift + respawn logic, per-entity `applyFormationPosition` update, bullet collection/advance/off-screen removal, `_bulletOffScreen`, `_respawnX`, and the `labelStyle`/`_addButton` UI helpers. Only the entity type, formation-offset builder, constants, fire method (`tryFireAimedBullet` / `tryFireSpreadBurst` / `tryFireRadialBurst`), status label and hint text differ.

This epic extracts that duplicated behaviour into a reusable core library, rewrites each gym scene to consume it, documents best practice for building enemy gym scenes, and brings the remaining enemy-gym-scene work items (E4 Phaser, E5 Swarm, Boss) into line with those best practices.

## Users

- **AI agents / developers implementing AI_Hell** — want one well-tested place for formation scenes so new enemy gym scenes (E4/E5/Boss) are thin, focused scene classes instead of another near-copy of the same 200-line boilerplate.

### Example user stories

- As a **developer**, I want a shared gym formation-scene base class that encapsulates spawn/UI/update/bullet lifecycle, so each new enemy gym scene supplies only its entity-specific config.
- As a **developer**, I want a `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` guide describing how to build enemy gym scenes with the core library before E4/E5/Boss are implemented.
- As a **developer**, I want E4/E5/Boss work items updated to mandate the core library + documented best practices, so the next scenes don't reintroduce duplication.

## Scope

- **In scope:** extract shared formation-scene base class + formation offset utilities (into a core library with unit tests); rewrite `GymScout`, `GymDiver`, `GymTank` to use them with behaviour preserved (existing scene test suites pass unchanged); write `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md`; update E4/E5/Boss work-item descriptions/ACs to require the best practices.
- **Out of scope:** implementing E4/E5/Boss scenes themselves; changing the Gym Index scene or discovery; player gym scene (`GymPlayer`) behaviour; any entity visual/behavioural redesign.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Core library exists:** A reusable core library (shared gym formation-scene base class parameterised by entity config + shared formation-offset builders) lives under `src/scenes/gym/core/` (or equivalent, excluded from index discovery) with unit tests, and the duplicated boilerplate is removed from the three rewritten scenes.
- [ ] **AC2 — Behaviour preserved:** `GymScout`, `GymDiver`, `GymTank` are rewritten to consume the core library with zero behaviour change — their existing per-scene test suites (`GymScout.test.ts`, `GymDiver.test.ts`, `GymTank.test.ts`) pass unchanged (full suite green).
- [ ] **AC3 — Documentation:** `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` documents best practice for building enemy gym scenes with the core library, including a new-scene checklist (config interface, discovery exclusion, test patterns, known gotchas such as `lineStyle()` after `clear()` and `add.existing`).
- [ ] **AC4 — Remaining scene work items updated:** E4 Phaser (`AH-0MT99K3FE008CT13`), E5 Swarm (`AH-0MT99N53O0077KHC`), and Boss (`AH-0MT99QBDW001O7PE`) work items are updated (description/ACs) to mandate the core library and reference `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md`.
- [ ] **AC5 — Discovery intact:** the Gym Index still lists and boots all three scenes (the core library is not listed as an entry).
- [ ] **AC6 — High-priority children:** this epic is decomposed into high-priority child work items covering library extraction, per-scene rewrites, documentation, and work-item updates.

## Dependencies

Depends on the completed first three enemy gym scenes: E1 Scout (`AH-0MT994ESD000RP1Q`), E2 Diver (`AH-0MT99G6310070UXM`), E3 Tank (`AH-0MT99I2OC0014MNZ`) — all `completed` (dependency edges already recorded).

## Priority

Critical — per original description ("will be critical priority"). It unblocks E4/E5/Boss and prevents triplication of boilerplate.

## Plan: Appendix — clarifying questions & answers

- Q: 'This epic-sized refactor (no ACs, no children, plan decision: plan) — shall I decompose it into high-priority children (extract core library, rewrite each scene, write the guide, update E4/E5/Boss work items), then implement the children via parent recursion?' Answer (operator): 'proceed'. Final: proceed — decompose then implement.
- Q (implicit, answered from code): 'What does the core library encapsulate?' Research: read GymScout/GymDiver/GymTank (220-240 lines each, ~90% identical), GymIndex + gymDiscovery glob (top-level  only ⇒ a  subfolder is excluded from discovery), entities (Scout/Diver/Tank) and shared utils (movement, gymNavigation, gymDiscovery). Evidence: src/scenes/gym/*.ts, src/utils/gymDiscovery.ts.
- Q (implicit, answered from description + worklog): 'Which remaining work items must be updated?' Answer: E4 Phaser (AH-0MT99K3FE008CT13), E5 Swarm (AH-0MT99N53O0077KHC), Boss (AH-0MT99QBDW001O7PE) — all open, from the completed epic AH-0MT987VA3005YBNK.

Effort/Risk: Small effort (expected ≈15h, recommended ≈23h incl. overheads), Low risk — see effort-and-risk run AH-0MT985FOA008JWM9.
